/-! ## Campanato Characterization of Hölder Spaces -/

/-- Admissible sub-balls of `Metric.ball x₀ R` for the Campanato seminorm. -/
def CampanatoBall (x₀ : E) (R : ℝ) :=
  {p : E × ℝ // 0 < p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ R ∧ Metric.ball p.1 p.2 ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R}

namespace CampanatoBall

def center {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : E := b.1.1

def radius {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : ℝ := b.1.2

lemma radius_pos {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : 0 < b.radius := b.2.1

lemma radius_le {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : b.radius ≤ R := b.2.2.1

lemma subset_ball {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    Metric.ball b.center b.radius ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R := b.2.2.2

end CampanatoBall

/-- The Campanato seminorm on a ball B_R(x₀):
sup_{B ⊆ B_R} ⨍_B |u - (u)_B|. -/
noncomputable def campanatoBallValue
    (u : E → ℝ) (α : ℝ) {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : ℝ :=
  (CampanatoBall.radius b)⁻¹ ^ α *
    ⨍ x in Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b),
      |u x - ⨍ z in Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b), u z| ∂volume

noncomputable def campanatoSeminorm (u : E → ℝ) (x₀ : E) (R : ℝ) (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup (Set.range (campanatoBallValue u α (x₀ := x₀) (R := R)))

lemma campanatoBallValue_nonneg
    {u : E → ℝ} {α : ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    0 ≤ campanatoBallValue u α b := by
  unfold campanatoBallValue
  apply mul_nonneg
  · exact Real.rpow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt b.radius_pos)) α
  · exact integral_nonneg (fun x => abs_nonneg _)
def HasCampanatoBound (u : E → ℝ) (x₀ : E) (R α C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : CampanatoBall x₀ R,
    IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b)) volume ∧
      campanatoBallValue u α b ≤ C

import DeGiorgi.Oscillation.BMO

/-!
# Chapter 02: Campanato and Holder Theory

This module packages the Campanato seminorm machinery and the equivalence with
Holder regularity.
-/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Metric Filter Set
open scoped ENNReal NNReal Topology

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {d : ℕ}

local notation "E" => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

/-! ## Campanato Characterization of Hölder Spaces -/

/-- Admissible sub-balls of `Metric.ball x₀ R` for the Campanato seminorm. -/
def CampanatoBall (x₀ : E) (R : ℝ) :=
  {p : E × ℝ // 0 < p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ R ∧ Metric.ball p.1 p.2 ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R}

namespace CampanatoBall

def center {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : E := b.1.1

def radius {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : ℝ := b.1.2

lemma radius_pos {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : 0 < b.radius := b.2.1

lemma radius_le {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : b.radius ≤ R := b.2.2.1

lemma subset_ball {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    Metric.ball b.center b.radius ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R := b.2.2.2

end CampanatoBall

/-- The Campanato seminorm on a ball B_R(x₀):
sup_{B ⊆ B_R} ⨍_B |u - (u)_B|. -/
noncomputable def campanatoBallValue
    (u : E → ℝ) (α : ℝ) {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : ℝ :=
  (CampanatoBall.radius b)⁻¹ ^ α *
    ⨍ x in Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b),
      |u x - ⨍ z in Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b), u z| ∂volume

noncomputable def campanatoSeminorm (u : E → ℝ) (x₀ : E) (R : ℝ) (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup (Set.range (campanatoBallValue u α (x₀ := x₀) (R := R)))

lemma campanatoBallValue_nonneg
    {u : E → ℝ} {α : ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    0 ≤ campanatoBallValue u α b := by
  unfold campanatoBallValue
  apply mul_nonneg
  · exact rpow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr b.radius_pos.le) α
  · exact integral_nonneg (fun x => abs_nonneg _)
def HasCampanatoBound (u : E → ℝ) (x₀ : E) (R α C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : CampanatoBall x₀ R,
    IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b)) volume ∧
      campanatoBallValue u α b ≤ C

noncomputable def dyadicBallAverage (u : E → ℝ) (x : E) (ρ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=

    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b)) volume :=
  (hcamp b).1

    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    campanatoBallValue u α b ≤ C :=

    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) (hR : 0 < R) :
    campanatoSeminorm u x₀ R α ≤ C := by
  unfold campanatoSeminorm
  apply csSup_le

  · rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩

  have b₀ : CampanatoBall x₀ R := ⟨⟨x₀, R⟩, hR, le_refl R, Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_refl R)⟩

import DeGiorgi.Oscillation.BMO

/-!
# Chapter 02: Campanato and Holder Theory

This module packages the Campanato seminorm machinery and the equivalence with
Holder regularity.
-/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Metric Filter Set
open scoped ENNReal NNReal Topology

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {d : ℕ}

local notation "E" => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

/-! ## Campanato Characterization of Hölder Spaces -/

/-- Admissible sub-balls of `Metric.ball x₀ R` for the Campanato seminorm. -/
def CampanatoBall (x₀ : E) (R : ℝ) :=
  {p : E × ℝ // 0 < p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ R ∧ Metric.ball p.1 p.2 ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R}

namespace CampanatoBall

def center {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : E := b.1.1

def radius {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : ℝ := b.1.2

lemma radius_pos {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : 0 < b.radius := b.2.1

lemma radius_le {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : b.radius ≤ R := b.2.2.1

lemma subset_ball {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    Metric.ball b.center b.radius ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R := b.2.2.2

end CampanatoBall

/-- The Campanato seminorm on a ball B_R(x₀):
sup_{B ⊆ B_R} ⨍_B |u - (u)_B|. -/
noncomputable def campanatoBallValue
    (u : E → ℝ) (α : ℝ) {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : ℝ :=
  (CampanatoBall.radius b)⁻¹ ^ α *
    ⨍ x in Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b),
      |u x - ⨍ z in Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b), u z| ∂volume

noncomputable def campanatoSeminorm (u : E → ℝ) (x₀ : E) (R : ℝ) (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup (Set.range (campanatoBallValue u α (x₀ := x₀) (R := R)))

lemma campanatoBallValue_nonneg
    {u : E → ℝ} {α : ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    0 ≤ campanatoBallValue u α b := by
  unfold campanatoBallValue
  apply mul_nonneg
  · exact Real.rpow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr b.radius_pos.le) α
  · exact integral_nonneg (fun x => abs_nonneg _)
def HasCampanatoBound (u : E → ℝ) (x₀ : E) (R α C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : CampanatoBall x₀ R,
    IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b)) volume ∧
      campanatoBallValue u α b ≤ C

noncomputable def dyadicBallAverage (u : E → ℝ) (x : E) (ρ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ⨍ z in Metric.ball x (ρ / (2 : ℝ) ^ n), u z ∂volume

lemma HasCampanatoBound.integrableOn
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b)) volume :=
  (hcamp b).1

lemma HasCampanatoBound.ballValue_le
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    campanatoBallValue u α b ≤ C :=
  (hcamp b).2

lemma HasCampanatoBound.campanatoSeminorm_le
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) (hR : 0 < R) :
    campanatoSeminorm u x₀ R α ≤ C := by
  unfold campanatoSeminorm
  apply csSup_le
  · exact ⟨_, ⟨⟨⟨x₀, R⟩, hR, le_refl R, Subset.refl _⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact hcamp.ballValue_le b

lemma HasCampanatoBound.nonneg
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (_hα : 0 < α) (hR : 0 < R) (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) :
    0 ≤ C := by
  have b₀ : CampanatoBall x₀ R := ⟨⟨x₀, R⟩, hR, le_refl R, Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_refl R)⟩
  exact le_trans (campanatoBallValue_nonneg b₀) (hcamp.ballValue_le b₀)
noncomputable def C_campanato_holder (d : ℕ) (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 : ℝ) ^ (d + 3) / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α))

lemma closedBall_ae_eq_ball_of_pos (x : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    Metric.closedBall x r =ᵐ[volume] Metric.ball x r := by
  rw [ae_eq_set]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Metric.closedBall_diff_ball]
    exact Measure.addHaar_sphere_of_ne_zero volume x hr.ne'
  · rw [Set.diff_eq_empty.mpr Metric.ball_subset_closedBall]
    exact measure_empty

lemma setAverage_closedBall_eq_ball_of_pos
    {u : E → ℝ} (x : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ⨍ z in Metric.closedBall x r, u z ∂volume = ⨍ z in Metric.ball x r, u z ∂volume := by
  congr 1
  exact Measure.restrict_congr_set (closedBall_ae_eq_ball_of_pos x hr)

lemma tendsto_dyadic_radius_nhdsWithin_zero {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ρ / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) atTop (𝓝[>] 0) := by sorry

lemma ball_subset_ball_of_mem_ball_half
    {x₀ x : E} {R r : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (R / 2)) (_hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrR : r ≤ R / 2) :
    Metric.ball x r ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R := by
  intro y hy
  rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx hy ⊢
  linarith [dist_triangle y x x₀]

lemma closedBall_subset_ball_of_mem_ball_half
    {x₀ x : E} {R r : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (R / 2)) (_hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrR : r ≤ R / 2) :
    Metric.closedBall x r ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R := by
  intro y hy
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hy
  rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx ⊢
  linarith [dist_triangle y x x₀]

lemma hasCampanatoBound_of_ballSubset

        ≤ C := by sorry

lemma le_mul_rpow_of_inv_rpow_mul_le
    {a C r α : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (h : r⁻¹ ^ α * a ≤ C) :
    a ≤ C * r ^ α := by
  have hr_pow : (0 : ℝ) < r⁻¹ ^ α := rpow_pos_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hr) α
  have key : a ≤ C * (r⁻¹ ^ α)⁻¹ := by
    rwa [← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ hr_pow, mul_comm]
  rwa [Real.inv_rpow hr.le, inv_inv] at key

lemma ballAverage_sub_ballAverage_sameRadius_le_campanato
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}

lemma dyadicBallAverage_step_le_campanato
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ x : E} {R α C ρ : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρR : ρ ≤ R) (hsub : Metric.ball x ρ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R)

    |dyadicBallAverage u x ρ n - dyadicBallAverage u x ρ (n + 1)|

import DeGiorgi.Common
import DeGiorgi.SobolevChainRule

/-!
# Chapter 02: Stampacchia

This module proves the Stampacchia truncation lemma used in the Sobolev and
iteration machinery.

## Proof strategy

**1D case**: if `f : ℝ → ℝ` is differentiable a.e., then `f' = 0` a.e. on `{f = 0}`.
Key insight: at a point where `f(x) = 0` and `f'(x) ≠ 0`, `x` is an isolated zero.
But isolated points of any set in ℝ are countable (hence measure 0).
So `{f = 0 ∧ f' ≠ 0}` is contained in a countable set and has measure 0.

**d-dimensional case**: reduce to 1D via Fubini. The restriction of `u ∈ W^{1,2}(ℝ^d)`
to a.e. coordinate line is in `W^{1,1}` (hence AC) with the right derivative.
Apply the 1D result on each line, recombine by Fubini.
-/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Metric Filter Topology Set Function intervalIntegral
open scoped ENNReal NNReal

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
local notation "E" => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

/-! ## Section 1: Pointwise 1D Stampacchia -/

/-- **Core lemma**: if `f` is differentiable at `x` with `f(x) = 0` and
`f'(x) ≠ 0`, then `f(x+h) ≠ 0` for all sufficiently small `h ≠ 0`.

Proof: the little-o condition gives `|f(x+h) - c·h| ≤ (|c|/2)·|h|` for small `h`.
Since `f(x) = 0`, triangle inequality gives `|f(x+h)| ≥ |c|·|h|/2 > 0`. -/
theorem deriv_ne_zero_implies_isolated_zero {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (hf : HasDerivAt f c x) (hfx : f x = 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ h, 0 < |h| → |h| < δ → f (x + h) ≠ 0 := by
  -- The little-o condition: f(x+h) = f(x) + c*h + o(h) = c*h + o(h)
  -- For |h| small enough, |f(x+h) - c*h| < |c|/2 * |h|
  -- So |f(x+h)| ≥ |c*h| - |f(x+h) - c*h| ≥ |c|*|h|/2 > 0
  have hf_lo := hf.hasFDerivAt.isLittleO
  rw [Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff] at hf_lo
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hf'⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hf_lo (half_pos (abs_pos.mpr hc)))
  refine ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, fun h hh_pos hh_lt => ?_⟩
  have hx_mem : x + h ∈ Metric.ball x δ₀ := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm, Real.dist_eq]
    simp [hh_lt]
  have key := hf' hx_mem
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    hfx, sub_zero, add_sub_cancel_left] at key
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs] at key
  intro hfxh
  rw [hfxh, zero_sub, abs_neg, abs_mul] at key
  have hc_pos := abs_pos.mpr hc
  have hh_abs_pos : (0 : ℝ) < |h| := hh_pos
  linarith [mul_pos hh_abs_pos hc_pos]
theorem HasDerivAt.deriv_eq_zero_of_zero_and_not_isolated {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x c : ℝ}
    (hf : HasDerivAt f c x) (hfx : f x = 0)
    (hni : ∀ δ > 0, ∃ y, y ≠ x ∧ |y - x| < δ ∧ f y = 0) :
    c = 0 := by
  by_contra hc
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hiso⟩ := deriv_ne_zero_implies_isolated_zero hf hfx hc
  obtain ⟨y, hyx, hy_close, hfy⟩ := hni δ hδ
  have : f (x + (y - x)) ≠ 0 := hiso (y - x)
    (by rwa [abs_pos, sub_ne_zero]) hy_close
  simp at this
  exact this hfy

/-! ## Section 2: Isolated points are countable → a.e. version -/

/-- In ℝ, the set of isolated points of any subset S is countable.

Proof: cover by ⋃_{p,q ∈ ℚ} {unique element of S in (p,q)}.
Each fiber has at most one element (uniqueness), and ℚ × ℚ is countable. -/
theorem countable_isolated (S : Set ℝ) :
    Set.Countable {x ∈ S | ∃ ε > 0, ∀ y ∈ S, dist y x < ε → y = x} := by sorry
theorem deriv_eq_zero_ae_on_zeroSet {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf_diff : ∀ᵐ x, HasDerivAt f (deriv f x) x) :
    ∀ᵐ x, f x = 0 → deriv f x = 0 := by sorry

/-! ## Section 3: 1D Sobolev → AC → Stampacchia

### Helper lemmas
-/

/-- Smooth (C^1) functions are absolutely continuous on intervals.
Proof: continuous derivative → bounded on compact [a,b] → Lipschitz → AC. -/

    AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval φ a b := by sorry

    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : IntegrableOn f (Ioo a b) volume)

private lemma integrable_of_smooth_cs {f : ℝ → ℝ}

private lemma support_sub_tsupport {f g : ℝ → ℝ} :
    support (f - g) ⊆ tsupport f ∪ tsupport g := by
  intro x hx
  rw [Function.mem_support, Pi.sub_apply] at hx
  by_contra habs
  simp only [Set.mem_union, not_or] at habs
  have hf : f x = 0 := by

theorem du_bois_reymond
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : IntegrableOn g (Ioo a b) volume)

    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) {u g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hu : IntegrableOn u (Ioo a b) volume)

    (hweak : ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      tsupport φ ⊆ Ioo a b →

    ∃ C : ℝ, u =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioo a b)]

    (hu : IntegrableOn u (Ioo a b) volume)

/-! ## Section 4: d-dimensional Stampacchia via truncation

Instead of Fubini, we use the truncation approach: compose u with smooth
approximations Φ_ε of the sign function, apply the Sobolev chain rule to get
∫ Φ_ε(u)·∂ᵢψ = -∫ Φ_ε'(u)·Gᵢ·ψ, then take ε → 0.
-/

/-- For each ε > 0, there exists a smooth truncation Φ_ε with Φ_ε(0) = 0,
|Φ_ε| ≤ ε, |Φ_ε'| ≤ 1, and Φ_ε'(s) = 1 for |s| ≤ ε/2.

Construction: take β = ContDiffBump 0 with rIn = ε/2, rOut = ε.
Define Φ(s) = ∫₀ˢ β(t) dt. Then Φ' = β, giving all properties. -/
private theorem exists_smooth_trunc (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Φ ∧ Φ 0 = 0 ∧
      (∀ s, |Φ s| ≤ ε) ∧ (∀ s, |deriv Φ s| ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ s, |s| ≤ ε / 2 → deriv Φ s = 1) ∧
      (∀ s, ε ≤ |s| → deriv Φ s = 0) := by sorry
private theorem exists_smooth_trunc' (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Φ ∧ Φ 0 = 0 ∧
      (∀ s, |Φ s| ≤ ε) ∧ (∀ s, |deriv Φ s| ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ s, |s| ≤ ε / 2 → deriv Φ s = 1) ∧
      (∀ s, ε ≤ |s| → deriv Φ s = 0) := by sorry

    {G : E → E} (hG : ∀ i, HasWeakPartialDeriv' i (fun x => G x i) u Ω) (i : Fin d)
    (hGi_mem : MemLp (fun x => G x i) 2 (volume.restrict Ω))
    (ψ : E → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ) (hψ_cs : HasCompactSupport ψ)
    (hψ_supp : tsupport ψ ⊆ Ω) :
    ∫ x, ψ x • (fun x => if u x = 0 then G x i else 0) x = 0 := by sorry

private theorem weakGrad_locallyIntegrableOn
    {Ω : Set E} (_hΩ : IsOpen Ω) {u : E → ℝ} (_hu : MemW1p 2 u Ω)
    {G : E → E} (_hG : ∀ i, HasWeakPartialDeriv' i (fun x => G x i) u Ω) (i : Fin d)

    (hu_meas : Measurable u) :

theorem weakGrad_ae_eq_zero_on_zeroSet

- weak-derivative uniqueness and approximation transfer;
- the canonical indicator-difference convergence theorem;
- the smooth positive-part chain rule;
- the auxiliary positive-part witness constructor.

witness data to positive-part closures that can be reused later in the De
Giorgi iteration.

private lemma indicator_diff_mul_le_abs {a c d : ℝ} :
    |(if 0 < a then d else 0) - (if 0 < c then d else 0)| ≤ |d| := by
  split_ifs <;> simp [abs_nonneg, abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub]

private lemma tendsto_indicator_diff_mul_zero_of_tendsto
    {a : ℕ → ℝ} {u g : ℝ}
    (ha : Tendsto a atTop (nhds u)) (hg0 : u = 0 → g = 0) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (if 0 < a n then g else 0) - (if 0 < u then g else 0))
      atTop (nhds 0) := by
  have h_eq : (fun n => (if 0 < a n then g else 0) - (if 0 < u then g else 0)) =ᶠ[atTop]
      (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy u 0 with hu | rfl | hu
    · filter_upwards [ha.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hu)] with n hn
      simp [show ¬(0 < a n) from not_lt.mpr hn.le, show ¬(0 < u) from not_lt.mpr hu.le]
    · simp [hg0 rfl]
    · filter_upwards [ha.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hu)] with n hn

/-! ## Poincare for `W^{1,p}` -/

/-- The ℓ² norm on `EuclideanSpace` is bounded by the ℓ¹ norm. -/
private lemma euclidean_norm_le_sum_norms (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
    ‖v‖ ≤ ∑ i : Fin d, ‖v i‖ := by
  have hv : v = ∑ i : Fin d, EuclideanSpace.single i (v i) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.sum_single v).symm
  calc ‖v‖ = ‖∑ i : Fin d, EuclideanSpace.single i (v i)‖ := by rw [hv]
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin d, ‖EuclideanSpace.single i (v i)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ i : Fin d, ‖v i‖ := by
        congr 1; ext i; rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_single]

/-- Admissible sub-balls of `Metric.ball x₀ R` for the Campanato seminorm. -/
def CampanatoBall (x₀ : E) (R : ℝ) :=
  {p : E × ℝ // 0 < p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ R ∧ Metric.ball p.1 p.2 ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R}

namespace CampanatoBall

def center {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : E := b.1.1

def radius {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : ℝ := b.1.2

lemma radius_pos {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : 0 < b.radius := b.2.1

lemma radius_le {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : b.radius ≤ R := b.2.2.1

lemma subset_ball {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    Metric.ball b.center b.radius ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R := b.2.2.2

end CampanatoBall

/-- The Campanato seminorm on a ball B_R(x₀):
sup_{B ⊆ B_R} ⨍_B |u - (u)_B|. -/
noncomputable def campanatoBallValue
    (u : E → ℝ) (α : ℝ) {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : ℝ :=
  (CampanatoBall.radius b)⁻¹ ^ α *
    ⨍ x in Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b),
      |u x - ⨍ z in Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b), u z| ∂volume

noncomputable def campanatoSeminorm (u : E → ℝ) (x₀ : E) (R : ℝ) (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup (Set.range (campanatoBallValue u α (x₀ := x₀) (R := R)))

lemma campanatoBallValue_nonneg
    {u : E → ℝ} {α : ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    0 ≤ campanatoBallValue u α b := by
  unfold campanatoBallValue
  apply mul_nonneg
  · exact Real.rpow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr b.radius_pos.le) α
  · exact integral_nonneg (fun x => abs_nonneg _)
def HasCampanatoBound (u : E → ℝ) (x₀ : E) (R α C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : CampanatoBall x₀ R,
    IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b)) volume ∧
      campanatoBallValue u α b ≤ C

noncomputable def dyadicBallAverage (u : E → ℝ) (x : E) (ρ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ⨍ z in Metric.ball x (ρ / (2 : ℝ) ^ n), u z ∂volume

lemma HasCampanatoBound.integrableOn
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b)) volume :=
  (hcamp b).1

lemma HasCampanatoBound.ballValue_le
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    campanatoBallValue u α b ≤ C :=
  (hcamp b).2

lemma HasCampanatoBound.campanatoSeminorm_le
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) (hR : 0 < R) :
    campanatoSeminorm u x₀ R α ≤ C := by
  unfold campanatoSeminorm
  apply csSup_le
  · exact ⟨_, ⟨⟨⟨x₀, R⟩, hR, le_refl R, Subset.refl _⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact hcamp.ballValue_le b

lemma HasCampanatoBound.nonneg
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (_hα : 0 < α) (hR : 0 < R) (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) :
    0 ≤ C := by
  have b₀ : CampanatoBall x₀ R := ⟨⟨x₀, R⟩, hR, le_refl R, Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_refl R)⟩
  exact le_trans (campanatoBallValue_nonneg b₀) (hcamp.ballValue_le b₀)
noncomputable def C_campanato_holder (d : ℕ) (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 : ℝ) ^ (d + 3) / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α))

lemma closedBall_ae_eq_ball_of_pos (x : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    Metric.closedBall x r =ᵐ[volume] Metric.ball x r := by
  rw [ae_eq_set]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Metric.closedBall_diff_ball]
    exact Measure.addHaar_sphere_of_ne_zero volume x hr.ne'
  · rw [Set.diff_eq_empty.mpr Metric.ball_subset_closedBall]
    exact measure_empty

lemma setAverage_closedBall_eq_ball_of_pos
    {u : E → ℝ} (x : E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ⨍ z in Metric.closedBall x r, u z ∂volume = ⨍ z in Metric.ball x r, u z ∂volume := by
  congr 1
  exact Measure.restrict_congr_set (closedBall_ae_eq_ball_of_pos x hr)

lemma tendsto_dyadic_radius_nhdsWithin_zero {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ρ / (2 : ℝ) ^ n) atTop (𝓝[>] 0) := by sorry

lemma ball_subset_ball_of_mem_ball_half
    {x₀ x : E} {R r : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (R / 2)) (_hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrR : r ≤ R / 2) :
    Metric.ball x r ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R := by
  intro y hy
  rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx hy ⊢
  linarith [dist_triangle y x x₀]

lemma closedBall_subset_ball_of_mem_ball_half
    {x₀ x : E} {R r : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (R / 2)) (_hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrR : r ≤ R / 2) :
    Metric.closedBall x r ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R := by
  intro y hy
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hy
  rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx ⊢
  linarith [dist_triangle y x x₀]

lemma hasCampanatoBound_of_ballSubset
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C)
    {x : E} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : r ≤ R)
    (hsub : Metric.ball x r ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R) :
    IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball x r) volume ∧
      r⁻¹ ^ α *
          ⨍ z in Metric.ball x r,
            |u z - ⨍ w in Metric.ball x r, u w| ∂volume
        ≤ C := by
  have b : CampanatoBall x₀ R := ⟨⟨x, r⟩, hr, hrR, hsub⟩
  exact hcamp b

lemma le_mul_rpow_of_inv_rpow_mul_le
    {a C r α : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (h : r⁻¹ ^ α * a ≤ C) :
    a ≤ C * r ^ α := by
  have hr_pow : (0 : ℝ) < r⁻¹ ^ α := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hr) α
  have key : a ≤ C * (r⁻¹ ^ α)⁻¹ := by
    rwa [← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ hr_pow, mul_comm]
  rwa [Real.inv_rpow hr.le, inv_inv] at key

lemma abs_ballAverage_half_sub_ballAverage_le

    (hr : 0 < r)

    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}

    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C_camp : ℝ}

    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C_hold : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < α) (hC_hold : 0 ≤ C_hold)
    (hhold : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ R, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ R,

    HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α (C_hold * (2 : ℝ) ^ α) := by sorry

    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C_hold : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < α) (hR : 0 < R) (hC_hold : 0 ≤ C_hold)

    campanatoSeminorm u x₀ R α ≤ C_hold * (2 : ℝ) ^ α := by sorry

/-!
# Support: Measure Bounds

Shared measure-theoretic lemmas for essential suprema, essential infima, and
restricted ball measures used throughout the weak Harnack, Harnack, and Moser
Holder layers.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]

theorem le_essInf_real_of_ae_le
    {μ : Measure E} (hμ : μ ≠ 0) {u : E → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (hlow : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, c ≤ u x) :
    c ≤ essInf u μ := le_essInf_of_ae_le c hlow

    volume.restrict (Metric.ball c r) ≠ 0 := by
  rw [ne_eq, Measure.restrict_eq_zero]
  exact (measure_ball_pos volume c hr).ne'

theorem essSup_le_of_ae_bdd
    {μ : Measure E} (hμ : μ ≠ 0)
    {u : E → ℝ} {K C : ℝ}
    (hlow : ∀ᵐ x ∂ μ, K ≤ u x)
    (hupp : ∀ᵐ x ∂ μ, u x ≤ C) :
    essSup u μ ≤ C := by
  simp only [essSup]
  haveI : NeBot (ae μ) := ae_neBot.mpr hμ

    (hu_bdd_above : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (ae μ) u) :

private theorem matMulE_norm_le_of_mixed_bound
    {Ω : Set E} (A : EllipticCoeff d Ω) {x : E}
    (hx : ∀ ξ ζ : E, |⟪ζ, matMulE (A.a x) ξ⟫_ℝ| ≤ A.Λ * ‖ζ‖ * ‖ξ‖)
    (ξ : E) :
    ‖matMulE (A.a x) ξ‖ ≤ A.Λ * ‖ξ‖ := by
  by_cases h0 : matMulE (A.a x) ξ = 0
  · rw [h0, norm_zero]; exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt A.Λ_pos) (norm_nonneg _)
  · have key := hx ξ (matMulE (A.a x) ξ)
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at key
    have hnorm_pos : 0 < ‖matMulE (A.a x) ξ‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr h0
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)] at key
    -- key : ‖matMulE (A.a x) ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ A.Λ * ‖matMulE (A.a x) ξ‖ * ‖ξ‖
    -- Divide both sides by ‖matMulE (A.a x) ξ‖
    have key' := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right key hnorm_pos
    rw [sq, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (ne_of_gt hnorm_pos), mul_assoc,
        mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (ne_of_gt hnorm_pos)] at key'
    exact key'

import DeGiorgi.Oscillation.BMO

/-!
# Chapter 02: Campanato and Holder Theory

This module packages the Campanato seminorm machinery and the equivalence with
Holder regularity.
-/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Metric Filter Set
open scoped ENNReal NNReal Topology

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {d : ℕ}

local notation "E" => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

/-! ## Campanato Characterization of Hölder Spaces -/

/-- Admissible sub-balls of `Metric.ball x₀ R` for the Campanato seminorm. -/
def CampanatoBall (x₀ : E) (R : ℝ) :=
  {p : E × ℝ // 0 < p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ R ∧ Metric.ball p.1 p.2 ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R}

namespace CampanatoBall

def center {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : E := b.1.1

def radius {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : ℝ := b.1.2

lemma radius_pos {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : 0 < b.radius := b.2.1

lemma radius_le {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : b.radius ≤ R := b.2.2.1

lemma subset_ball {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    Metric.ball b.center b.radius ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R := b.2.2.2

end CampanatoBall

/-- The Campanato seminorm on a ball B_R(x₀):
sup_{B ⊆ B_R} ⨍_B |u - (u)_B|. -/
noncomputable def campanatoBallValue
    (u : E → ℝ) (α : ℝ) {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) : ℝ :=
  (CampanatoBall.radius b)⁻¹ ^ α *
    ⨍ x in Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b),
      |u x - ⨍ z in Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b), u z| ∂volume

noncomputable def campanatoSeminorm (u : E → ℝ) (x₀ : E) (R : ℝ) (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup (Set.range (campanatoBallValue u α (x₀ := x₀) (R := R)))

lemma campanatoBallValue_nonneg
    {u : E → ℝ} {α : ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R : ℝ} (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    0 ≤ campanatoBallValue u α b := by
  unfold campanatoBallValue
  apply mul_nonneg
  · exact Real.rpow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr b.radius_pos.le) α
  · exact integral_nonneg (fun x => abs_nonneg _)
def HasCampanatoBound (u : E → ℝ) (x₀ : E) (R α C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : CampanatoBall x₀ R,
    IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b)) volume ∧
      campanatoBallValue u α b ≤ C

noncomputable def dyadicBallAverage (u : E → ℝ) (x : E) (ρ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ⨍ z in Metric.ball x (ρ / (2 : ℝ) ^ n), u z ∂volume

lemma HasCampanatoBound.integrableOn
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball (CampanatoBall.center b) (CampanatoBall.radius b)) volume :=
  (hcamp b).1

lemma HasCampanatoBound.ballValue_le
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) (b : CampanatoBall x₀ R) :
    campanatoBallValue u α b ≤ C :=
  (hcamp b).2

lemma HasCampanatoBound.campanatoSeminorm_le
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}
    (hcamp : HasCampanatoBound u x₀ R α C) (hR : 0 < R) :
    campanatoSeminorm u x₀ R α ≤ C := by
  unfold campanatoSeminorm
  apply csSup_le
  · exact ⟨_, ⟨⟨⟨x₀, R⟩, hR, le_refl R, Subset.refl _⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact hcamp.ballValue_le b

lemma HasCampanatoBound.nonneg
    {u : E → ℝ} {x₀ : E} {R α C : ℝ}

    0 ≤ C := by
  have b₀ : CampanatoBall x₀ R := ⟨⟨x₀, R⟩, hR, le_refl R, Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_refl R)⟩
  exact le_trans (campanatoBallValue_nonneg b₀) (hcamp.ballValue_le b₀)

import DeGiorgi.Supersolutions
import DeGiorgi.Crossover
import DeGiorgi.Support.MeasureBounds

/-!
# Chapter 06: Weak Harnack Inequality

This file proves the weak Harnack inequality for positive supersolutions,
combining the forward and inverse Moser estimates with the crossover bound.

## Proof strategy

Set `p₀ = c_crossover'(d) / Λ^{1/2}`. The proof chains three ingredients
at half scale (rescaling `v(z) = u(z/2)` from `B_{1/2}` to `B_1`):

1. **Forward Moser** on `v`: LHS on `B_{1/4}`, RHS = `C · ∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{p₀}`
2. **Crossover** on `u`: `∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{p₀} · ∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{-p₀} ≤ C · vol²`
3. **Inverse Moser** on `v`: `(∫_{B_{1/2}} |u⁻¹|^{p₀})⁻¹ ≤ C · (essInf_{B_{1/4}} u)^{p₀}`

All intermediate integrals match on `B_{1/2}`. Output on `B_{1/4}`.

## Dependencies

- `Supersolutions` for the two stage theorems
- `Crossover` for `crossover_estimate_unaveraged`
- `BallScaling` (transitively) for rescaling infrastructure
-/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Metric

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]

local notation "E" => AmbientSpace d

/-! ### Constants -/

/-- The exponent `dχ / c_crossover'(d)` on `(1-q)`. -/
noncomputable def weak_harnack_decay_exp (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] : ℝ :=
  ((d : ℝ) * moserChi d) / c_crossover' d

/-! ### Arithmetic helpers -/

private theorem c_crossover_bmo_scale_nonneg : 0 ≤ c_crossover_bmo_scale d := by sorry

private theorem c_crossover_bmo_scale_pos : 0 < c_crossover_bmo_scale d := by sorry

theorem c_crossover'_pos : 0 < c_crossover' (d := d) := by
  unfold c_crossover'
  apply div_pos one_pos
  linarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (C_JN_pos d).le)
    (c_crossover_bmo_scale_nonneg (d := d))]

theorem c_crossover'_lt_one : c_crossover' (d := d) < 1 := by sorry

theorem weak_harnack_decay_exp_nonneg (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ)) :
    0 ≤ weak_harnack_decay_exp d := by
  unfold weak_harnack_decay_exp
  apply div_nonneg
  · apply mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d)
    unfold moserChi
    exact div_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d) (by linarith)
  · exact c_crossover'_pos.le

private theorem isSupersolution_add_const_unitBall
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1))
    {u : E → ℝ} (hsuper : IsSupersolution A.1 u)
    (c : ℝ) :
    IsSupersolution A.1 (fun x => u x + c) := by sorry

omit [NeZero d] in
private theorem essInf_add_const
    {μ : Measure E} (hμ : μ ≠ 0) {u : E → ℝ} (c : ℝ)
    (hu_bdd_below : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) (ae μ) u)
    (hu_shift_bdd_below : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) (ae μ) (fun x => u x + c)) :
    essInf (fun x => u x + c) μ = essInf u μ + c := by sorry

theorem one_le_Λ_of_normalized
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1)) :
    1 ≤ A.1.Λ := by
  have := A.1.hΛ; rw [A.2] at this; exact this
noncomputable def weakHarnackP0
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1)) : ℝ :=
  c_crossover' d / A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)

theorem p₀_pos
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1)) :
    0 < weakHarnackP0 A := by
  unfold weakHarnackP0
  apply div_pos c_crossover'_pos
  exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (one_le_Λ_of_normalized A)) _

theorem p₀_le_crossover'
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1)) :
    weakHarnackP0 A ≤ c_crossover' d := by
  unfold weakHarnackP0
  have hΛ_pos : (0 : ℝ) < A.1.Λ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (one_le_Λ_of_normalized A)
  have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := by
    calc (1 : ℝ) = 1 ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := by simp [Real.one_rpow]
      _ ≤ A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := by
          apply Real.rpow_le_rpow (by norm_num) (one_le_Λ_of_normalized A) (by norm_num)
  exact div_le_self c_crossover'_pos.le h1

theorem p₀_lt_one
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1)) :
    weakHarnackP0 A < 1 := by
  calc weakHarnackP0 A ≤ c_crossover' d := p₀_le_crossover' A
    _ < 1 := c_crossover'_lt_one

theorem Λ_mul_p₀_sq
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1)) :
    A.1.Λ * weakHarnackP0 A ^ 2 = c_crossover' d ^ 2 := by
  unfold weakHarnackP0
  have hΛ_pos : (0 : ℝ) < A.1.Λ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (one_le_Λ_of_normalized A)

  have hΛ_half_sq : (A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) ^ 2 = A.1.Λ := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast (A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) 2,
        ← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hΛ_pos)]
    norm_num
  rw [hΛ_half_sq, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (ne_of_gt hΛ_pos)]

private noncomputable def rescaledCoeff

    NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1) :=
  rescaleNormalizedCoeffToUnitBall (d := d) (x₀ := (0 : E)) (R := 1 / 2)
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)
    (A.restrict (ball_subset_ball (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1)))

private theorem integral_rescale_ball

private theorem integral_rescale_ball_general

    ∫ z in ball (0 : E) ρ, f ((R : ℝ) • z) ∂volume =
      (R ^ Module.finrank ℝ E)⁻¹ * ∫ x in ball (0 : E) (R * ρ), f x ∂volume := by sorry

private theorem quarterBall_volume_real_le_one :
    volume.real (ball (0 : E) (1 / 4 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by sorry

    (hr : 0 < r) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (hu_aesm : AEStronglyMeasurable u (volume.restrict (ball (0 : E) (1 / 4 : ℝ))))

private noncomputable def C_chainGeom (_hd : 2 < (d : ℝ)) : ℝ :=
  ((((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (-(d : ℝ))) + 1) ^ 2) *
    ((volume.real (ball (0 : E) (1 / 2 : ℝ)) + 1) ^ 2) *
    ((c_crossover' d ^ 2 + 1) ^

import DeGiorgi.Supersolutions
import DeGiorgi.Crossover
import DeGiorgi.Support.MeasureBounds

/-!
# Chapter 06: Weak Harnack Inequality

This file proves the weak Harnack inequality for positive supersolutions,
combining the forward and inverse Moser estimates with the crossover bound.

## Proof strategy

Set `p₀ = c_crossover'(d) / Λ^{1/2}`. The proof chains three ingredients
at half scale (rescaling `v(z) = u(z/2)` from `B_{1/2}` to `B_1`):

1. **Forward Moser** on `v`: LHS on `B_{1/4}`, RHS = `C · ∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{p₀}`
2. **Crossover** on `u`: `∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{p₀} · ∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{-p₀} ≤ C · vol²`
3. **Inverse Moser** on `v`: `(∫_{B_{1/2}} |u⁻¹|^{p₀})⁻¹ ≤ C · (essInf_{B_{1/4}} u)^{p₀}`

All intermediate integrals match on `B_{1/2}`. Output on `B_{1/4}`.

## Dependencies

- `Supersolutions` for the two stage theorems
- `Crossover` for `crossover_estimate_unaveraged`
- `BallScaling` (transitively) for rescaling infrastructure
-/

/-- The exponent `dχ / c_crossover'(d)` on `(1-q)`. -/
noncomputable def weak_harnack_decay_exp (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] : ℝ :=

/-! ### Arithmetic helpers -/

private theorem c_crossover_bmo_scale_pos : 0 < c_crossover_bmo_scale d := by sorry

theorem c_crossover'_pos : 0 < c_crossover' (d := d) := by
  unfold c_crossover'
  apply div_pos one_pos
  linarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (C_JN_pos d).le)
    (c_crossover_bmo_scale_nonneg (d := d))]

theorem c_crossover'_lt_one : c_crossover' (d := d) < 1 := by sorry

theorem weak_harnack_decay_exp_nonneg (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ)) :
    0 ≤ weak_harnack_decay_exp d := by
  unfold weak_harnack_decay_exp
  apply div_nonneg
  · apply mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d)
    unfold moserChi
    exact div_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d) (by linarith)
  · exact c_crossover'_pos.le

private theorem isSupersolution_add_const_unitBall
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1))
    {u : E → ℝ} (hsuper : IsSupersolution A.1 u)

    (hu_shift_bdd_below : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) (ae μ) (fun x => u x + c)) :

theorem one_le_Λ_of_normalized
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1)) :

    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1)) : ℝ :=

  have hΛ_half_sq : (A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) ^ 2 = A.1.Λ := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast (A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) 2,

    norm_num

private noncomputable def rescaledCoeff

/-- If `x ^ a ≤ C * y ^ p` with `x, C, y ≥ 0` and `p > 0`, then
`x ^ (a / p) ≤ C ^ (1 / p) * y`. -/
private theorem rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent
    {x C y a p : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hp : 0 < p) (_ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (h : x ^ a ≤ C * y ^ p) :
    x ^ (a / p) ≤ C ^ (1 / p) * y := by
  have hp_inv : 0 < 1 / p := div_pos one_pos hp
  have step1 : x ^ (a / p) = (x ^ a) ^ (1 / p) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hx]; ring_nf
  rw [step1]
  have step2 : C ^ (1 / p) * y = (C * y ^ p) ^ (1 / p) := by
    rw [mul_rpow hC (Real.rpow_nonneg hy p), ← Real.rpow_mul hy]
    congr 1; field_simp
  rw [step2]
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hx a) h hp_inv.le

/-- **Weak Harnack inequality** for positive supersolutions on `B₁`.

For `u > 0` with `-∇·(A∇u) ≥ 0` on `B₁`, and `0 < q < 1`:
```
‖u‖_{L^{q*}(B_{1/4})} ≤ (C(d)/(1-q)^{d/c'})^{Λ^{1/2}} · essInf_{B_{1/4}} u
```

The estimate is stated on `B_{1/4}`, the ball naturally produced by the
forward and inverse Moser steps together with the crossover estimate. -/
theorem weak_harnack
    (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ))
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1))
    {u : E → ℝ} {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1)
    (hu_pos : ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : E) 1, 0 < u x)
    (hsuper : IsSupersolution A.1 u) :
    (∫ x in ball (0 : E) (1 / 4 : ℝ),
        |u x| ^ (q * (d : ℝ) / ((d : ℝ) - 2)) ∂volume) ^
          (((d : ℝ) - 2) / (q * (d : ℝ))) ≤
      (C_weakHarnack d hd / (1 - q) ^ (weak_harnack_decay_exp d)) ^
        (A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) *
        essInf u (volume.restrict (ball (0 : E) (1 / 4 : ℝ))) := by sorry

import DeGiorgi.Supersolutions
import DeGiorgi.Crossover
import DeGiorgi.Support.MeasureBounds

/-!
# Chapter 06: Weak Harnack Inequality

This file proves the weak Harnack inequality for positive supersolutions,
combining the forward and inverse Moser estimates with the crossover bound.

## Proof strategy

Set `p₀ = c_crossover'(d) / Λ^{1/2}`. The proof chains three ingredients
at half scale (rescaling `v(z) = u(z/2)` from `B_{1/2}` to `B_1`):

1. **Forward Moser** on `v`: LHS on `B_{1/4}`, RHS = `C · ∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{p₀}`
2. **Crossover** on `u`: `∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{p₀} · ∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{-p₀} ≤ C · vol²`
3. **Inverse Moser** on `v`: `(∫_{B_{1/2}} |u⁻¹|^{p₀})⁻¹ ≤ C · (essInf_{B_{1/4}} u)^{p₀}`

All intermediate integrals match on `B_{1/2}`. Output on `B_{1/4}`.

## Dependencies

- `Supersolutions` for the two stage theorems
- `Crossover` for `crossover_estimate_unaveraged`
- `BallScaling` (transitively) for rescaling infrastructure
-/

noncomputable section

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]

local notation "E" => AmbientSpace d

/-! ### Constants -/

/-- The exponent `dχ / c_crossover'(d)` on `(1-q)`. -/
noncomputable def weak_harnack_decay_exp (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] : ℝ :=
  ((d : ℝ) * moserChi d) / c_crossover' d

/-! ### Arithmetic helpers -/

private theorem c_crossover_bmo_scale_nonneg : 0 ≤ c_crossover_bmo_scale d := by sorry

private theorem c_crossover_bmo_scale_pos : 0 < c_crossover_bmo_scale d := by sorry

theorem c_crossover'_pos : 0 < c_crossover' (d := d) := by
  unfold c_crossover'
  apply div_pos one_pos
  linarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (C_JN_pos d).le)
    (c_crossover_bmo_scale_nonneg (d := d))]

theorem c_crossover'_lt_one : c_crossover' (d := d) < 1 := by sorry

theorem weak_harnack_decay_exp_nonneg (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ)) :
    0 ≤ weak_harnack_decay_exp d := by
  unfold weak_harnack_decay_exp
  apply div_nonneg
  · apply mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d)
    unfold moserChi
    exact div_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d) (by linarith)
  · exact c_crossover'_pos.le

private theorem isSupersolution_add_const_unitBall
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1))
    {u : E → ℝ} (hsuper : IsSupersolution A.1 u)
    (c : ℝ) :
    IsSupersolution A.1 (fun x => u x + c) := by sorry

    {μ : Measure E} (hμ : μ ≠ 0) {u : E → ℝ} (c : ℝ)

    (hu_shift_bdd_below : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) (ae μ) (fun x => u x + c)) :

/-! ### Rpow exponent helper -/

/-- If `x ^ a ≤ C * y ^ p` with `x, C, y ≥ 0` and `p > 0`, then
`x ^ (a / p) ≤ C ^ (1 / p) * y`. -/
private theorem rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent
    {x C y a p : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hp : 0 < p) (_ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (h : x ^ a ≤ C * y ^ p) :
    x ^ (a / p) ≤ C ^ (1 / p) * y := by
  have hp_inv : 0 < 1 / p := div_pos one_pos hp
  have step1 : x ^ (a / p) = (x ^ a) ^ (1 / p) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hx]; ring_nf
  rw [step1]
  have step2 : C ^ (1 / p) * y = (C * y ^ p) ^ (1 / p) := by
    rw [mul_rpow hC (Real.rpow_nonneg hy p), ← Real.rpow_mul hy]
    congr 1; field_simp
  rw [step2]
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hx a) h hp_inv.le

/-! ### Main theorem -/

/-- **Weak Harnack inequality** for positive supersolutions on `B₁`.

For `u > 0` with `-∇·(A∇u) ≥ 0` on `B₁`, and `0 < q < 1`:
```
‖u‖_{L^{q*}(B_{1/4})} ≤ (C(d)/(1-q)^{d/c'})^{Λ^{1/2}} · essInf_{B_{1/4}} u
```

The estimate is stated on `B_{1/4}`, the ball naturally produced by the
forward and inverse Moser steps together with the crossover estimate. -/
theorem weak_harnack
    (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ))
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1))
    {u : E → ℝ} {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1)
    (hu_pos : ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : E) 1, 0 < u x)
    (hsuper : IsSupersolution A.1 u) :
    (∫ x in ball (0 : E) (1 / 4 : ℝ),
        |u x| ^ (q * (d : ℝ) / ((d : ℝ) - 2)) ∂volume) ^
          (((d : ℝ) - 2) / (q * (d : ℝ))) ≤
      (C_weakHarnack d hd / (1 - q) ^ (weak_harnack_decay_exp d)) ^
        (A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) *
        essInf u (volume.restrict (ball (0 : E) (1 / 4 : ℝ))) := by sorry

import DeGiorgi.Supersolutions
import DeGiorgi.Crossover
import DeGiorgi.Support.MeasureBounds

/-!
# Chapter 06: Weak Harnack Inequality

This file proves the weak Harnack inequality for positive supersolutions,
combining the forward and inverse Moser estimates with the crossover bound.

## Proof strategy

Set `p₀ = c_crossover'(d) / Λ^{1/2}`. The proof chains three ingredients
at half scale (rescaling `v(z) = u(z/2)` from `B_{1/2}` to `B_1`):

1. **Forward Moser** on `v`: LHS on `B_{1/4}`, RHS = `C · ∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{p₀}`
2. **Crossover** on `u`: `∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{p₀} · ∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{-p₀} ≤ C · vol²`
3. **Inverse Moser** on `v`: `(∫_{B_{1/2}} |u⁻¹|^{p₀})⁻¹ ≤ C · (essInf_{B_{1/4}} u)^{p₀}`

All intermediate integrals match on `B_{1/2}`. Output on `B_{1/4}`.

## Dependencies

- `Supersolutions` for the two stage theorems
- `Crossover` for `crossover_estimate_unaveraged`
- `BallScaling` (transitively) for rescaling infrastructure
-/

noncomputable section

theorem c_crossover'_pos : 0 < c_crossover' (d := d) := by
  unfold c_crossover'
  apply div_pos one_pos
  linarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (C_JN_pos d).le)
    (c_crossover_bmo_scale_nonneg (d := d))]

theorem c_crossover'_lt_one : c_crossover' (d := d) < 1 := by sorry

theorem weak_harnack_decay_exp_nonneg (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ)) :

  unfold weak_harnack_decay_exp
  apply div_nonneg
  · apply mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d)
    unfold moserChi
    exact div_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d) (by linarith)
  · exact c_crossover'_pos.le

    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1)) : ℝ :=

  apply div_pos c_crossover'_pos
  exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (one_le_Λ_of_normalized A)) _

  unfold weakHarnackP0
  have hΛ_pos : (0 : ℝ) < A.1.Λ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (one_le_Λ_of_normalized A)
  have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := by
    calc (1 : ℝ) = 1 ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := by simp [Real.one_rpow]
      _ ≤ A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := by
          apply Real.rpow_le_rpow (by norm_num) (one_le_Λ_of_normalized A) (by norm_num)
  exact div_le_self c_crossover'_pos.le h1

    _ < 1 := c_crossover'_lt_one

  unfold weakHarnackP0
  have hΛ_pos : (0 : ℝ) < A.1.Λ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (one_le_Λ_of_normalized A)
  have hΛ_half_pos : (0 : ℝ) < A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) :=
    Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hΛ_pos _
  have hΛ_half_sq : (A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) ^ 2 = A.1.Λ := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast (A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) 2,
        ← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hΛ_pos)]
    norm_num
  rw [div_pow, hΛ_half_sq, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hΛ_pos)]

    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hx]; ring_nf

  have step2 : C ^ (1 / p) * y = (C * y ^ p) ^ (1 / p) := by
    rw [mul_rpow hC (Real.rpow_nonneg hy p), ← Real.rpow_mul hy]
    congr 1; field_simp
  rw [step2]
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hx a) h hp_inv.le

/-- **Weak Harnack inequality** for positive supersolutions on `B₁`.

For `u > 0` with `-∇·(A∇u) ≥ 0` on `B₁`, and `0 < q < 1`:
```
‖u‖_{L^{q*}(B_{1/4})} ≤ (C(d)/(1-q)^{d/c'})^{Λ^{1/2}} · essInf_{B_{1/4}} u
```

The estimate is stated on `B_{1/4}`, the ball naturally produced by the
forward and inverse Moser steps together with the crossover estimate. -/
theorem weak_harnack
    (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ))
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1))
    {u : E → ℝ} {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1)
    (hu_pos : ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : E) 1, 0 < u x)
    (hsuper : IsSupersolution A.1 u) :
    (∫ x in ball (0 : E) (1 / 4 : ℝ),
        |u x| ^ (q * (d : ℝ) / ((d : ℝ) - 2)) ∂volume) ^
          (((d : ℝ) - 2) / (q * (d : ℝ))) ≤
      (C_weakHarnack d hd / (1 - q) ^ (weak_harnack_decay_exp d)) ^
        (A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) *
        essInf u (volume.restrict (ball (0 : E) (1 / 4 : ℝ))) := by sorry

import DeGiorgi.Supersolutions
import DeGiorgi.Crossover
import DeGiorgi.Support.MeasureBounds

/-!
# Chapter 06: Weak Harnack Inequality

This file proves the weak Harnack inequality for positive supersolutions,
combining the forward and inverse Moser estimates with the crossover bound.

## Proof strategy

Set `p₀ = c_crossover'(d) / Λ^{1/2}`. The proof chains three ingredients
at half scale (rescaling `v(z) = u(z/2)` from `B_{1/2}` to `B_1`):

1. **Forward Moser** on `v`: LHS on `B_{1/4}`, RHS = `C · ∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{p₀}`
2. **Crossover** on `u`: `∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{p₀} · ∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{-p₀} ≤ C · vol²`
3. **Inverse Moser** on `v`: `(∫_{B_{1/2}} |u⁻¹|^{p₀})⁻¹ ≤ C · (essInf_{B_{1/4}} u)^{p₀}`

All intermediate integrals match on `B_{1/2}`. Output on `B_{1/4}`.

## Dependencies

- `Supersolutions` for the two stage theorems
- `Crossover` for `crossover_estimate_unaveraged`
- `BallScaling` (transitively) for rescaling infrastructure
-/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Metric

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]

local notation "E" => AmbientSpace d

/-! ### Constants -/

/-- The exponent `dχ / c_crossover'(d)` on `(1-q)`. -/
noncomputable def weak_harnack_decay_exp (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] : ℝ :=
  ((d : ℝ) * moserChi d) / c_crossover' d

/-! ### Arithmetic helpers -/

private theorem c_crossover_bmo_scale_nonneg : 0 ≤ c_crossover_bmo_scale d := by sorry

private theorem c_crossover_bmo_scale_pos : 0 < c_crossover_bmo_scale d := by sorry

theorem c_crossover'_pos : 0 < c_crossover' (d := d) := by
  unfold c_crossover'
  apply div_pos one_pos
  linarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (C_JN_pos d).le)
    (c_crossover_bmo_scale_nonneg (d := d))]

theorem c_crossover'_lt_one : c_crossover' (d := d) < 1 := by sorry

theorem weak_harnack_decay_exp_nonneg (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ)) :
    0 ≤ weak_harnack_decay_exp d := by
  unfold weak_harnack_decay_exp
  apply div_nonneg
  · apply mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d)
    unfold moserChi
    exact div_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d) (by linarith)
  · exact c_crossover'_pos.le

private theorem isSupersolution_add_const_unitBall
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1))
    {u : E → ℝ} (hsuper : IsSupersolution A.1 u)
    (c : ℝ) :
    IsSupersolution A.1 (fun x => u x + c) := by sorry

    {μ : Measure E} (hμ : μ ≠ 0) {u : E → ℝ} (c : ℝ)
    (hu_bdd_below : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) (ae μ) u)
    (hu_shift_bdd_below : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) (ae μ) (fun x => u x + c)) :
    essInf (fun x => u x + c) μ = essInf u μ + c := by sorry

theorem one_le_Λ_of_normalized
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1)) :
    1 ≤ A.1.Λ := by
  have := A.1.hΛ; rw [A.2] at this; exact this
noncomputable def weakHarnackP0
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1)) : ℝ :=
  c_crossover' d / A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)

theorem p₀_pos
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1)) :
    0 < weakHarnackP0 A := by
  unfold weakHarnackP0
  apply div_pos c_crossover'_pos
  exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (one_le_Λ_of_normalized A)) _

theorem p₀_le_crossover'
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1)) :
    weakHarnackP0 A ≤ c_crossover' d := by
  unfold weakHarnackP0
  have hΛ_pos : (0 : ℝ) < A.1.Λ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (one_le_Λ_of_normalized A)
  have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := by
    calc (1 : ℝ) = 1 ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := by simp [Real.one_rpow]
      _ ≤ A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := by
          apply Real.rpow_le_rpow (by norm_num) (one_le_Λ_of_normalized A) (by norm_num)
  exact div_le_self c_crossover'_pos.le h1

theorem p₀_lt_one
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1)) :
    weakHarnackP0 A < 1 := by
  calc weakHarnackP0 A ≤ c_crossover' d := p₀_le_crossover' A
    _ < 1 := c_crossover'_lt_one

theorem Λ_mul_p₀_sq
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1)) :
    A.1.Λ * weakHarnackP0 A ^ 2 = c_crossover' d ^ 2 := by
  unfold weakHarnackP0
  have hΛ_pos : (0 : ℝ) < A.1.Λ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (one_le_Λ_of_normalized A)
  have hΛ_half_pos : (0 : ℝ) < A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) :=
    Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hΛ_pos _
  have hΛ_half_sq : (A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) ^ 2 = A.1.Λ := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast (A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) 2,
        ← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hΛ_pos)]
    norm_num
  rw [div_pow, hΛ_half_sq, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hΛ_pos)]

private noncomputable def rescaledCoeff
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1)) :
    NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1) :=
  rescaleNormalizedCoeffToUnitBall (d := d) (x₀ := (0 : E)) (R := 1 / 2)
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)
    (A.restrict (ball_subset_ball (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1)))

private theorem rescaledCoeff_Λ_eq
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1)) :
    (rescaledCoeff A).1.Λ = A.1.Λ := by sorry

private noncomputable def C_chainGeom (_hd : 2 < (d : ℝ)) : ℝ :=

    (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ))

    {u : E → ℝ} {q : ℝ}

/-- If `x ^ a ≤ C * y ^ p` with `x, C, y ≥ 0` and `p > 0`, then
`x ^ (a / p) ≤ C ^ (1 / p) * y`. -/
private theorem rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent
    {x C y a p : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hp : 0 < p) (_ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (h : x ^ a ≤ C * y ^ p) :

  have hp_inv : 0 < 1 / p := div_pos one_pos hp
  have step1 : x ^ (a / p) = (x ^ a) ^ (1 / p) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hx]; ring_nf
  rw [step1]
  have step2 : C ^ (1 / p) * y = (C * y ^ p) ^ (1 / p) := by
    rw [mul_rpow hC (Real.rpow_nonneg hy p), ← Real.rpow_mul hy]
    congr 1; field_simp
  rw [step2]
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hx a) h hp_inv.le

/-- **Weak Harnack inequality** for positive supersolutions on `B₁`.

For `u > 0` with `-∇·(A∇u) ≥ 0` on `B₁`, and `0 < q < 1`:
```
‖u‖_{L^{q*}(B_{1/4})} ≤ (C(d)/(1-q)^{d/c'})^{Λ^{1/2}} · essInf_{B_{1/4}} u
```

The estimate is stated on `B_{1/4}`, the ball naturally produced by the
forward and inverse Moser steps together with the crossover estimate. -/
theorem weak_harnack
    (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ))
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1))
    {u : E → ℝ} {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1)
    (hu_pos : ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : E) 1, 0 < u x)
    (hsuper : IsSupersolution A.1 u) :
    (∫ x in ball (0 : E) (1 / 4 : ℝ),
        |u x| ^ (q * (d : ℝ) / ((d : ℝ) - 2)) ∂volume) ^
          (((d : ℝ) - 2) / (q * (d : ℝ))) ≤
      (C_weakHarnack d hd / (1 - q) ^ (weak_harnack_decay_exp d)) ^
        (A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) *
        essInf u (volume.restrict (ball (0 : E) (1 / 4 : ℝ))) := by sorry

/-!
# Chapter 06: Weak Harnack Inequality

This file proves the weak Harnack inequality for positive supersolutions,
combining the forward and inverse Moser estimates with the crossover bound.

## Proof strategy

Set `p₀ = c_crossover'(d) / Λ^{1/2}`. The proof chains three ingredients
at half scale (rescaling `v(z) = u(z/2)` from `B_{1/2}` to `B_1`):

1. **Forward Moser** on `v`: LHS on `B_{1/4}`, RHS = `C · ∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{p₀}`
2. **Crossover** on `u`: `∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{p₀} · ∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{-p₀} ≤ C · vol²`
3. **Inverse Moser** on `v`: `(∫_{B_{1/2}} |u⁻¹|^{p₀})⁻¹ ≤ C · (essInf_{B_{1/4}} u)^{p₀}`

All intermediate integrals match on `B_{1/2}`. Output on `B_{1/4}`.

## Dependencies

- `Supersolutions` for the two stage theorems
- `Crossover` for `crossover_estimate_unaveraged`
- `BallScaling` (transitively) for rescaling infrastructure
-/

    (c_crossover_bmo_scale_nonneg (d := d))]

private theorem rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent
    {x C y a p : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hp : 0 < p) (_ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (h : x ^ a ≤ C * y ^ p) :

  have hp_inv : 0 < 1 / p := div_pos one_pos hp
  have step1 : x ^ (a / p) = (x ^ a) ^ (1 / p) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hx]; ring_nf

    rw [Real.mul_rpow hC (Real.rpow_nonneg hy p), ← Real.rpow_mul hy]

  rw [step2]
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hx a) h hp_inv.le

import DeGiorgi.Supersolutions
import DeGiorgi.Crossover
import DeGiorgi.Support.MeasureBounds

/-!
# Chapter 06: Weak Harnack Inequality

This file proves the weak Harnack inequality for positive supersolutions,
combining the forward and inverse Moser estimates with the crossover bound.

## Proof strategy

Set `p₀ = c_crossover'(d) / Λ^{1/2}`. The proof chains three ingredients
at half scale (rescaling `v(z) = u(z/2)` from `B_{1/2}` to `B_1`):

1. **Forward Moser** on `v`: LHS on `B_{1/4}`, RHS = `C · ∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{p₀}`
2. **Crossover** on `u`: `∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{p₀} · ∫_{B_{1/2}} |u|^{-p₀} ≤ C · vol²`
3. **Inverse Moser** on `v`: `(∫_{B_{1/2}} |u⁻¹|^{p₀})⁻¹ ≤ C · (essInf_{B_{1/4}} u)^{p₀}`

All intermediate integrals match on `B_{1/2}`. Output on `B_{1/4}`.

## Dependencies

- `Supersolutions` for the two stage theorems
- `Crossover` for `crossover_estimate_unaveraged`
- `BallScaling` (transitively) for rescaling infrastructure
-/

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]

local notation "E" => AmbientSpace d

/-! ### Constants -/

/-- The exponent `dχ / c_crossover'(d)` on `(1-q)`. -/
noncomputable def weak_harnack_decay_exp (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] : ℝ :=
  ((d : ℝ) * moserChi d) / c_crossover' d

/-! ### Arithmetic helpers -/

private theorem c_crossover_bmo_scale_nonneg : 0 ≤ c_crossover_bmo_scale d :=
  crossover_bmo_scale_nonneg

private theorem c_crossover_bmo_scale_pos : 0 < c_crossover_bmo_scale d := by sorry

theorem c_crossover'_pos : 0 < c_crossover' (d := d) := by
  unfold c_crossover'
  apply div_pos one_pos
  linarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (C_JN_pos d).le)
    (c_crossover_bmo_scale_nonneg (d := d))]

theorem c_crossover'_lt_one : c_crossover' (d := d) < 1 := by sorry

theorem weak_harnack_decay_exp_nonneg (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ)) :
    0 ≤ weak_harnack_decay_exp d := by
  unfold weak_harnack_decay_exp
  apply div_nonneg
  · apply mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d)
    unfold moserChi
    exact div_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d) (by linarith)
  · exact c_crossover'_pos.le

private theorem isSupersolution_add_const_unitBall
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (ball (0 : E) 1))
    {u : E → ℝ} (hsuper : IsSupersolution A.1 u)
    (c : ℝ) :

    (hu_shift_bdd_below : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) (ae μ) (fun x => u x + c)) :

  have hΛ_half_sq : (A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) ^ 2 = A.1.Λ := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast (A.1.Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) 2,
        ← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hΛ_pos)]

    {c y : E}

  simp only [harnackChainCenter, AffineMap.lineMap_apply]

    rw [div_le_one (by norm_num : (16 : ℝ) > 0)]

    _ = ‖(1 - (n : ℝ) / 16) • c + (n : ℝ) / 16 • y‖ := by

    _ ≤ ‖(1 - (n : ℝ) / 16) • c‖ + ‖(n : ℝ) / 16 • y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = |1 - (n : ℝ) / 16| * ‖c‖ + |(n : ℝ) / 16| * ‖y‖ := by

        have hy' : ‖y‖ < 1 / 2 := by rwa [← dist_zero_right] at hy

/-!
# Chapter 07: Harnack Consequences

This module proves the Harnack inequality from the De Giorgi-Moser chain and
packages the constants used later in the Moser Holder theorem.

The focus here is the endpoint comparison argument on nested balls. Iteration
machinery belongs upstream in the De Giorgi, Moser, and weak Harnack modules.
-/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]

local notation "E" => AmbientSpace d
local notation "μ1" => volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1)
local notation "μhalf" => volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : E) (1 / 2 : ℝ))

/-- An a.e. upper bound on the half ball upgrades to an essential-supremum
bound on the half ball. -/
theorem essSup_halfBall_le_of_ae_bound
    {u : E → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
    (h_nonneg : ∀ᵐ x ∂μhalf, 0 ≤ u x)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂μhalf, u x ≤ C) :
    essSup u μhalf ≤ C := by
  exact essSup_le_of_ae_bdd (restrict_ball_ne_zero (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)) h_nonneg hbound

set_option maxHeartbeats 5000000 in
omit [NeZero d] in
/-- An a.e. lower bound on the half ball upgrades to an essential-infimum
bound on the half ball. -/
theorem le_essInf_halfBall_of_ae_bound
    {u : E → ℝ} {c C : ℝ}
    (hlow : ∀ᵐ x ∂μhalf, c ≤ u x)
    (hupp : ∀ᵐ x ∂μhalf, u x ≤ C) :

private theorem harnack_dim_ge_three (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ)) : 3 ≤ d := by

  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hc

        have hy' : ‖y‖ < 1 / 2 := by rwa [← dist_zero_right] at hy
        gcongr
        · linarith
        · exact hc'
        · exact hn0
        · exact hy'

    {c y : E}
    (hc : c ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) (1 / 2 : ℝ))

    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hc hy

      _ ≤ dist y 0 + dist 0 c := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ < 1 / 2 + 1 / 2 := by
          rw [dist_comm 0 c]
          exact add_lt_add hy hc
      _ = 1 := by norm_num

    (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ))

import DeGiorgi.Supersolutions.ForwardIteration.Energy

/-!
# Supersolutions Forward One-Step Estimate

This module contains the one-step forward reverse-Holder estimate for positive
supersolutions.
-/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Metric

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]

local notation "E" => AmbientSpace d
local notation "μhalf" => (volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : E) (1 / 2 : ℝ)))

/-- One-step Sobolev gain for positive supersolutions, forward low-power case.

For `p ∈ (0,1)` and `0 < r < s ≤ 1`, if `u > 0` is a supersolution on `B₁`, then
```
‖u‖_{L^{pχ}(Bᵣ)} ≤ C^{1/p} (Λp²/(1-p)² + 1)^{1/p} (s-r)^{-2/p} ‖u‖_{Lᵖ(Bₛ)}
```
-/
theorem supersolution_preMoser_forward
    (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ))
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1))
    {u : E → ℝ} {p r s : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hrs : r < s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1)
    (hu_pos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) 1, 0 < u x)
    (hsuper : IsSupersolution A.1 u)
    (hpInt :
      IntegrableOn (fun x => |u x| ^ p)
        (Metric.ball (0 : E) s) volume) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x => |u x| ^ (moserChi d * p))
        (Metric.ball (0 : E) r) volume ∧
      (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E) r,
          |u x| ^ (moserChi d * p) ∂volume) ^
          (1 / (moserChi d * p)) ≤
        ((C_MoserAnchor d / (s - r) ^ 2) *
            (A.1.Λ * (p / (1 - p)) ^ 2 + 1)) ^ (1 / p) *
          (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E) s, |u x| ^ p ∂volume) ^ (1 / p) := by sorry
theorem supersolution_reverseHolder_forward
    (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ))
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1))
    {u : E → ℝ} {p r s : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hrs : r < s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1)
    (hu_pos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E) 1, 0 < u x)
    (hsuper : IsSupersolution A.1 u)
    (hpInt :
      IntegrableOn (fun x => |u x| ^ p)
        (Metric.ball (0 : E) s) volume) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x => |u x| ^ (moserChi d * p))
        (Metric.ball (0 : E) r) volume ∧
      (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E) r,
          |u x| ^ (moserChi d * p) ∂volume) ^
          (1 / (moserChi d * p)) ≤
        ((C_MoserAnchor d / (s - r) ^ 2) *
            (A.1.Λ * (p / (1 - p)) ^ 2 + 1)) ^ (1 / p) *
          (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E) s, |u x| ^ p ∂volume) ^ (1 / p) := by sorry


end DeGiorgi

```

apply `superPowerCutoff_energy_bound` to get the W^{1,2} energy bound, then
apply the Sobolev inequality to `v = η · u^{-p/2}` to obtain the Lᵖ → Lᵖˣ gain.
The final step is norm arithmetic converting from L²* to Lᵖˣ. -/

          (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E) s, |(u x)⁻¹| ^ p ∂volume) ^ (1 / p) := by sorry

theorem localMoserBase_pos (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ)) :
    0 < localMoserBase d := by
  unfold localMoserBase
  apply mul_pos (mul_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one one_le_C_Moser) _) _
  · exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) - 1) _
  · exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4) _

theorem localWeakHarnackBase_pos (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] :
    0 < localWeakHarnackBase d := by sorry

theorem one_le_localMoserBase (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ)) :
    1 ≤ localMoserBase d := by
  unfold localMoserBase
  have hd_pos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) := by positivity
  calc (1 : ℝ) ≤ C_Moser d := one_le_C_Moser
    _ = C_Moser d * 1 * 1 := by ring
    _ ≤ C_Moser d * ((d : ℝ) - 1) ^ (d : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ (d : ℝ) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (le_trans zero_le_one one_le_C_Moser)
        apply mul_le_mul
        · exact Real.one_le_rpow (by linarith : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) - 1) hd_pos
        · exact Real.one_le_rpow (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (4 : ℝ)) hd_pos
        · exact zero_le_one
        · exact le_trans zero_le_one (Real.one_le_rpow (by linarith) hd_pos)

theorem one_le_localWeakHarnackBase (d : ℕ) [NeZero d] (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ)) :
    1 ≤ localWeakHarnackBase d := by sorry

end DeGiorgi

import DeGiorgi.Supersolutions.RegularizationSupport

/-!
# Supersolutions Forward Iteration Basics

This module contains the forward cutoff definition and the basic setup lemmas
for the forward low-power supersolution iteration.
-/

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Metric

namespace DeGiorgi

variable {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]

local notation "E" => AmbientSpace d
local notation "μhalf" => (volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : E) (1 / 2 : ℝ)))

/-- Forward low-power energy bound for `η · u^{p/2}` where `p ∈ (0,1)`.

This is the analogue of `superPowerCutoff_energy_bound` for positive powers
of `u` (not `u⁻¹`). The Caccioppoli inequality gives `(1-p)` in the denominator
instead of `(1+p)`.

The proof is the same test-function computation as the inverse case but with
`p ↦ -p` substitution. When `p ∈ (-1,0)` in the general formula, we get
`u^{-(-p)/2} = u^{p/2}` and `1 + (-p) = 1 - p`. -/
noncomputable def superPowerCutoffFwd
    (η u : E → ℝ) (p : ℝ) : E → ℝ :=
  fun x => η x * |u x| ^ (p / 2)

omit [NeZero d] in
theorem superPowerCutoff_neg_eq_fwd
    {u η : E → ℝ} {p : ℝ}
    (hu_pos : ∀ x, 0 < u x) :
    superPowerCutoff (d := d) η u (-p) = superPowerCutoffFwd (d := d) η u p := by sorry

theorem exists_forward_iteration_depth
    (hd : 2 < (d : ℝ))
    {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p < q) :
    ∃ m : ℕ,
      let p₀ := q * (moserChi d)⁻¹ ^ m
      p₀ < p ∧ p ≤ moserChi d * p₀ := by sorry

theorem supersolution_integrableOn_ball_one_rpow
    (A : NormalizedEllipticCoeff d (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1))
    {u : E → ℝ} {p : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp2 : p ≤ 2)
    (hsuper : IsSupersolution A.1 u) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x => |u x| ^ p) (Metric.ball (0 : E) 1) volume := by sorry

omit [NeZero d] in
theorem superPowerCutoffFwd_tsupport_subset
    {u η : E → ℝ} {p s : ℝ}
    (hη_sub_ball : tsupport η ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E) s) :
